notes.title: The Void Update is now available for download
Release!
notes.notes:
Hello! Path to Heaven has become available for purchase.

The game includes up to 5 hours of content and that's not all. In the future, I plan to release two updates: Void and Challenge Update. These two updates will bring about 2-5 hours of new content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374806/cbbbfcac862b1fbaa455770f86adb144720472ab.jpg

Void Update is ten new levels and the completion of the story that was started in Path to Heaven. It will add many different obstacles and traps to the game.

Challenge Update is a different trials for a player. You will need to pass the levels over time, without deaths and more.

I plan to release both updates by the end of the summer.
Thanks to everyone who bought the game. Have a good trip to Heaven!
